content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository pulp-platform_common_cells_pr93, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# stream_register: Error in Synopsys Synplify
Hi all,
I'm facing a problem using the stream_register required for using Pulp AXI. This module is included in the axi_atop_filter. Unfortunately I get the following error message during compilation with Synopsys Synplify :
**@E: CD671: /.../commom_cells/src/stream_register.sv: 36:31:36:31| Expecting array type.**
If I change the code from
```
fifo_v2 #(
.FALL_THROUGH   (1'b0),
.DATA_WIDTH     ($size(T)),                     // <= change done here: $size() replaced with $bits()
.DEPTH          (1),
.dtype          (T)
) i_fifo (
.clk_i          (clk_i),
.rst_ni         (rst_ni),
.flush_i        (clr_i),
.testmode_i     (testmode_i),
.full_o         (fifo_full),
.empty_o        (fifo_empty),
.alm_full_o     ( ),
.alm_empty_o    ( ),
.data_i         (data_i),
.push_i         (valid_i & ~fifo_full),
.data_o         (data_o),
.pop_i          (ready_i & ~fifo_empty)
);
```
to
```
fifo_v2 #(
.FALL_THROUGH   (1'b0),
.DATA_WIDTH     ($bits(T)),                    // <= this is working
.DEPTH          (1),
.dtype          (T)
) i_fifo (
.clk_i          (clk_i),
.rst_ni         (rst_ni),
.flush_i        (clr_i),
.testmode_i     (testmode_i),
.full_o         (fifo_full),
.empty_o        (fifo_empty),
.alm_full_o     ( ),
.alm_empty_o    ( ),
.data_i         (data_i),
.push_i         (valid_i & ~fifo_full),
.data_o         (data_o),
.pop_i          (ready_i & ~fifo_empty)
);
```
but I think then the module does not have the intended behaviour any more. Does anybody know what the exact error is because I don't get the problem.
**I simulate the whole design with MentorGraphics Questa and there it works without any problem. So it seems to be a problem with the Synthesis tool.**
Kind regards and thank you very much for helping!
Sebastian

Please review the issue description and thoroughly analyze the issue to uncover all possible causes.
Then, review the skeletons of potentially relevant files and identify up to FOUR files that are most likely to require edits to resolve the issue.

IMPORTANT:
1. Select files ONLY FROM THE PROVIDED FILE LIST and specify their FULL PATHS.
2. The returned files should be separated by new lines ordered by most to least important. Wrap the file list in triple backticks (```).

Explain your reasoning, then provide your answer in the following format:
```
full_path1/file1.py
full_path2/file2.py
```

I focused on the fact that Synplify is choking on the use of $size in the stream_register wrapper (which instantiates a depth‐1 FIFO), and that the fix is to switch all such uses over to $bits. That means touching the stream_register itself, the FIFO it instantiates, and any higher‐level wrapper that passes the same parameters. In our tree the four most likely files are:

```text
common_cells/src/stream_register.sv
common_cells/src/fifo_v2.sv
common_cells/src/axi_atop_filter.sv
common_cells/src/common_cells_pkg.sv
```

Explanation:

1. stream_register.sv  
   – This is where the bad `.DATA_WIDTH($size(T))` call lives and must be changed to `$bits(T)` (and any other `$size(T)` occurrences in this file).

2. fifo_v2.sv  
   – The FIFO itself may also use `$size` internally (or have parameter docs); switch them over to `$bits`.

3. axi_atop_filter.sv  
   – Since this file brings in `stream_register`, if it ever overrides or references the same `$size(T)` logic it must be updated.

4. common_cells_pkg.sv  
   – This package likely carries typedefs or local parameters for streams; check for any `$size()` usage and convert to `$bits()`.
